general.note: New Bundle: Dark Twilight Xal'atath Bundle (Xal'atath, Twilight Xal'atath Skin, Sin'dorei Phoenix Mount).
Added the ability to ping your Healing Fountain cooldown.

notes: Shambler Health and damage now begin 25% below their previous values and gradually return to their previous values over the course of the match.

heroes.name: Xal'atath
notes: Shadow Mark [Q]: Void Orb that deals 75 damage, plus 150 in the center. Heroes and Structures hit by the center are Marked for 4 seconds, Revealed, and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions toward them.

Dark Heart Ritual [W]: Summon the Dark Heart for 8 seconds, pulsing 50 damage per second. It moves to Shadow Mark's impact and detonates on Marked targets for 305 damage, plus 150 to the Marked target.
Void Step [E]: Teleport 3 times in a triangle. Each teleport adds 10% Basic Attack damage while active, up to 30%. Reactivate to end early.

Void Volley [Trait]: After 5 Basic Attacks, fire 6 Void Orbs at a location for 90 damage each. Quest: hit Heroes to gain stacks, with rewards at 20, 60 and 100 stacks (Mythic: +50% Basic Attack and Void Volley damage, projectiles Pierce).
Void Eruption [R]: Channel a growing Void Orb that Blinds enemies it touches and explodes at the end of its path for up to 700 damage.
Void Convergence [R]: After a 2 second channel, summon a Void Portal that Slows nearby enemies and spawns up to 3 Void Minions for 12 seconds.

heroes.name: Abathur
notes: Bombard Strain (Level 13): Health decay reduction lowered from 50% to 40%.
Survival Instincts (Level 16): Now provides 50% damage reduction against non-Heroes, instead of +100% Health.

heroes.name: Alexstrasza
notes: Health increased from 1698 to 1780.
Flames of Fury (Level 1): Mythic Reward requirement reduced from 40 extra hits without dying to 30.
Overprotective (Level 16): Shield reduced from 70% of healing to 50%.

heroes.name: Garrosh
notes: Unrivaled Strength (Level 1): Damage bonus reduced from 125% to 75%.
In For The Kill (Level 4): Damage bonus increased from 70% to 100%.
Oppressor (Level 7): Spell Power reduction decreased from 30% to 25%.
Bloodcraze (Level 13): Heal duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds. Total healing remains the same.
Double Up (Level 13): Armor duration increased from 3 to 5 seconds.

heroes.name: Mal'Ganis
notes: Night Rush [E]: Cast time reduced from 0.75 to 0.625 seconds.
Vampiric Touch [D]: Healing from damage against Heroes increased from 45% to 50%, and against non-Heroes from 10% to 15%.

heroes.name: Qhira
notes: Blood Rage [W]: Damage bonus per stack decreased from 0.25% to 0.2%. Base damage per tick lowered from 8 to 7.
Fatal Wounds (Level 1): Damage bonus against low Health targets increased from 50% to 70%.
Pulsing Pain (Level 13): Damage increased from 135 to 150.
Lingering Ailment (Level 16): Armor reduction decreased from 35 to 25.

heroes.name: Whitemane
notes: Desperate Plea [Q]: Base Mana cost increased from 40 to 45. Mana scaling with each use is unchanged.
Intercession (Level 7): Cooldown increased from 60 to 75 seconds.
Radiance (Level 16): Healing increased from 175 to 190.

heroes.name: Yrel
notes: Vindication [Q]: Mana cost increased from 50 to 65.
Aldor Peacekeeper (Level 13): Damage reduction increased from 40% to 50%, and its duration from 3 to 4 seconds.
Velen's Chosen (Level 13): Damage bonus per stack decreased from 10% to 8%. Stacks increased from 3 to 4.
Seraphim (Level 20): Cooldown increased from 20 to 30 seconds.
Fixed an issue where the fort walls on one side had more Health than the other.

heroes.name: Anduin
notes: Leap of Faith: fixed an issue that caused it to be delayed when cast on Rooted Heroes.

heroes.name: Malfurion
notes: Entangling Roots: fixed an issue where it would not continuously Root enemies within its area.
Entangling Roots: fixed an issue that prevented it from applying on first contact.

heroes.name: Ragnaros
notes: Heroic Difficulty: fixed an issue that granted 25% more damage and duration.
Heroic Difficulty: Molten Core's cooldown when selected decreased from 90 to 70 seconds.

heroes.name: Xul
notes: Fixed an issue where Xul's skeletons were sometimes not dealing damage.
